meta.tagline: Elevate your body, empower your mind

hero.subtitle: A boutique Reformer Pilates studio where intimate classes of four and expert, personal coaching help you reconnect, realign and grow stronger.

method.heading: Strength, breath & balance
method.body: We blend classical and contemporary Pilates with a holistic approach that supports both body and mind. In intimate classes of just four, every session is guided, personal and built around your progress.

points.title: Intimate classes of four
points.text: Personalised guidance on every reformer, every session.

points.title: Expert, personal coaching
points.text: Helena and the team coach technique, activation and control.

points.title: Body & mind, together
points.text: A calm, empowering space where your progress is our purpose.

method.founderQuote: It's more than movement — it's a calm, empowering space where your progress is our purpose.

media.alt: Woman practising Reformer Pilates in a bright studio

classes.heading: Find your practice
classes.intro: Six signature classes, one calm, empowering space — from gentle foundations to full-strength fire.

list.name: Rise Gentle Earth
list.text: A beginner-friendly welcome for those new to reformer, healing from injury, or returning to movement at a slower pace.

list.name: Rise Earth
list.text: Our foundation class for all levels — technique, muscle activation and control.

list.name: Rise Fire
list.text: Classical Pilates with a contemporary twist. Strong, dynamic, for intermediate to advanced.

list.name: Rise Core + Glutes
list.text: A contemporary class focused on core and glutes — pulses, holds and Pilates shakes.

list.name: Rise Air
list.text: A calm, meditative class for flexibility, deep stretching and breath work.

list.name: Rise Forge
list.text: Reformer precision meets kettlebell power. For experienced clients who want to be forged.
